description: This is a Kotlin source file implementing a Jetpack Compose UI screen named TaskListScreen for a to-do list app. It defines composable functions to render a task list with a top app bar, a floating action button, and individual task items with checkbox, description, and edit/delete actions.

methods.name: TaskListScreen
methods.description: Main composable function displaying the task list with UI components and user interactions.

methods.name: TaskItem
methods.description: Private composable rendering individual task details, including checkbox, description, and action icons.

methods.name: ActionsInline
methods.description: Private helper composable arranging edit and delete icons inline with fixed offsets.
